title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive

Manchester City Centre

£25k basic uncapped OTE

The Role

As our client continues to grow, we're looking to bring a hungry, commercially minded Business Development Executive into the team.

This is a front line role in a fast moving finance brokerage, perfect for someone who enjoys conversations with business owners, understands sales fundamentals and wants a clear path to progression.

What you'll be doing:
- Speaking with UK SMEs about funding requirements, specifically focussing on invoice finance and cashflow lending.
- Managing inbound lead flow (we will give you lots of leads).
- Building your own network & outbound lead origination strategy.
- Building long-term relationships with introducers, clients and lenders.

What we're looking for:
- Confident communicator (phone-first mindset).
- Commercial curiosity. finance experience is a bonus, not essential.
- Resilient, driven, and organised.
- Someone who wants to build a career, not just do a job.

What's in it for you:
- Competitive base + industry leading lifetime commission scheme.
- Working closely with the directors on a daily basis.
- Uncapped earning potential.
- Small, ambitious company with real momentum (100% year on year growth since incorporation).
- Central Manchester office location and get to work with three top fellas!

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Pickfords is an iconic British brand, moving excellence is our passion and we have been relocating families and businesses locally and across the world for over 350 years.

We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic individual to join our Move Manager Team, with a passion for customer service and a desire to exceed our clients expectations.

Job Purpose

As a Move Manager, you will be the customer's main point of contact throughout their move, delivering excellent customer service and ensuring every move is managed smoothly from enquiry to completion.

Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will coordinate each move, maintain accurate records, identify sales opportunities and provide a seamless, stress-free experience for every customer.

Key Responsibilities
- Be the customer's dedicated point of contact throughout their moving journey.
- Understand customer needs and deliver an outstanding customer experience.
- Identify opportunities to promote and upsell relevant products and services.
- Process customer documentation accurately and in line with company procedures and legal requirements.
- Manage customer enquiries, quotes, bookings and administration efficiently within agreed timescales.
- Deliver excellent customer service while achieving agreed KPIs and performance targets.
- Resolve customer queries and issues promptly and professionally.
- Build strong working relationships with colleagues and other departments to ensure moves run smoothly.
- Participate in team meetings, briefings and training, sharing ideas and best practice.
- Carry out any other duties appropriate to the role.

Key Performance Areas
- Manage incoming calls and customer enquiries professionally and promptly.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records within the CRM system.
- Maximise enquiry to quote and booking through effective sales and customer service.
- Follow the three-call process to maximise sales opportunities and deliver excellent customer service.
- Process customer payments accurately in line with company procedures.
- Resolve customer queries and complaints efficiently.
- Deliver exceptional customer service that encourages positive feedback, online reviews and recommendations.
- Follow company policies, procedures and compliance standards to ensure a consistent, high-quality customer experience.

Skills, Knowledge & Experience
- Excellent communication and listening skills, with the ability to build rapport with customers and colleagues.
- Strong customer focus with a passion for delivering outstanding service.
- Positive, enthusiastic and self-motivated with a proactive, can-do attitude.
- Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads.
- Flexible and adaptable, responding positively to changing priorities.
- Calm and professional when working under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
- Results-driven with a commitment to delivering work to a high standard.
- A team player who enjoys collaborating and sharing best practice.
- Motivated to achieve personal and team objectives.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel and Outlook.

If you are a motivated individual with a passion for logistics and relocation services, we would love to hear from you. 'Apply' now to join our dynamic team.

Candidates will only be contacted if they are invited for an interview. You must be eligible to work in the UK.

We are committed to equal opportunities for all, irrespective of race, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sexuality, disability, marital status or age.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Work Location: In person

title: Netsuite Account Manager
description:
NetSuite Account Manager - Enterprise Financial Services

Chapman Tate Associates is proud to be partnering with a leading NetSuite Partner specialising in the Enterprise Financial Services sector. Due to continued growth, we're seeking an experienced NetSuite Account Manager to take ownership of an established portfolio of enterprise customers while playing a key role in driving long-term client success.

This is an outstanding opportunity for an ambitious Account Manager who enjoys building trusted relationships, delivering strategic value, and helping customers maximise their investment in NetSuite solutions.

You'll have full ownership of a diverse portfolio of enterprise Financial Services customers, acting as the primary commercial contact throughout the customer lifecycle. Working alongside highly experienced consultants and delivery teams, you'll identify opportunities to expand existing accounts, strengthen client relationships, and ensure customers continue to realise value from their NetSuite investment.

This role offers genuine autonomy, the opportunity to influence strategic client engagements, and a clear pathway for career progression within a growing and respected NetSuite Partner.

Key Responsibilities:
- Take full ownership of a diverse portfolio of enterprise Financial Services customers.
- Develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and key decision-makers.
- Drive account growth through upselling, cross-selling, and identifying new opportunities.
- Lead account planning, commercial reviews, and renewal discussions.
- Collaborate closely with delivery and consulting teams to ensure exceptional customer outcomes.
- Understand customer business objectives and align NetSuite solutions to their strategic goals.
- Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline activity.
- Stay up to date with NetSuite product developments and industry trends.

You'll be a commercially focused Account Manager with experience managing ERP or SaaS customer relationships and a passion for delivering exceptional client experiences.

We're looking for someone with:
- Experience managing NetSuite accounts or other ERP platforms.
- A proven background in Account Management, Customer Success, or ERP sales.
- Experience working with enterprise-level customers, ideally within Financial Services.
- Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
- A proactive, customer-first approach with the ability to build long-term partnerships.

Package on offer:
- Competitive basic salary with an uncapped bonus structure.
- The opportunity to manage and grow a high-value customer portfolio.
- Hybrid and flexible working.
- Ongoing professional development and NetSuite training.
- Clear career progression within a growing NetSuite Partner.
- A collaborative, supportive, and high-performing team environment.

If you're looking for an opportunity where you'll have genuine ownership of your accounts, the autonomy to build lasting client relationships, and the chance to work with some of the UK's leading enterprise Financial Services organisations, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Chapman Tate Associates for a confidential discussion.

title: Temporary Outbound Customer Advisor - Warm Enquiries
description:
OUTBOUND CUSTOMER SUCCESS ADVISOR

Salford M50- Parking onsite

Monday- Friday (Fulltime in the office)

9am-5pm

13.33 per hour ( 26k)

ASAP - Ongoing (Possibility to be extended or taken on permanently for the right person)

Are you ready to make a difference in the retail appliance industry? Our client is on the lookout for a dynamic and enthusiastic Outbound Customer Success Advisor to join their growing team at their head office in Salford! If you thrive in a high-volume call environment and enjoy helping customers succeed, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Do:
As a pivotal member of the team, your mission will be to connect with customers and enhance their experience with our client's Reward scheme. Here's what you can expect to do:
- Engage Customers: Reach out to customers who have onboarded but haven't yet claimed their rewards, guiding them through the claims process with care and clarity.
- Support Onboarding: Assist customers who faced challenges during onboarding, diagnosing issues and ensuring they complete the process smoothly.
- Customer Satisfaction Checks: Follow up with customers who have recently had products installed to gauge their satisfaction with the product and service.
- Issue Logging: Identify and log any concerns raised, escalating issues as needed to ensure prompt resolutions.
- Quote Progression: Contact customers who have requested quotes but haven't provided necessary information to move forward.
- Follow-Up: Reconnect with customers who haven't responded to previous requests for additional information.
- Remove Blockers: Work diligently to eliminate any obstacles in the quoting process, striving to convert more inquiries into booked and paid installations.
- Record Keeping: Maintain accurate records of all calls, outcomes and customer interactions in the CRM system.
- Feedback Loop: Collaborate closely with the Customer Service Manager to report common issues or trends.
- Brand Representation: Always represent the company professionally, reflecting brand values and building customer trust.

What We're Looking For:
To succeed in this role, you should possess the following qualities:
- Rapport Builder: An ability to connect quickly with customers and maintain a friendly telephone manner.
- Problem Solver: A keen mindset for identifying key issues and offering effective resolutions.
- Efficient Worker: An organised and conscientious approach to managing multiple call types throughout your day.
- Tech-Savvy: Basic IT literacy to effectively utilise CRM systems and tools.

Performance Measures:
Your success will be measured by:
- The number of successfully completed calls leading to customer onboarding.
- The number of quotes progressed to booked and paid.
- Call volume and quality against set targets.
- The number of 4- and 5-star customer reviews generated as a result of your outbound efforts.

Apply Now!
